forfeit 25 steps · unlimited count

TRUNCATION — StepCount ≥ 3000
the only way an episode ends

span.p:
Π max(0.01, term)^w
weighted geometric mean
× 1 / MaxStep(3000)
− 0.05 · LastActionDelta01

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
positive-definite by design
a negative per-step term plus a
terminable episode makes falling
the fastest way to stop losing points

span.p: GAIT GATE — gen 15

color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
alternation = clamp01(switchRate / (1/35))
EMA of stance CHANGES, τ ≈ 2 s
full credit at a 0.7 s swap = 1.4 Hz

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
supportReward ×= alternation
faded in by gaitBlend so StandStill
is never punished for planting

span.p:
standing = 0 · hopping = 0
only swapping scores

span.p: EXTRINSIC TERM TREE — weights are EXPONENTS, not addends

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
uprightReward = max(0, up·Y)²
w = 0.15

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
speedMatchReward = exp(−err² / 0.3²)
signed along goal dir
w = 0.50

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
supportReward
min(1, max(single, clearance)
+ (1−blend)·double·(1−clearance))
w = 0.30

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
clearanceReward = Lerp(1, clearance, blend)
clearance = swingLift / 0.05 m
zeroed when BOTH feet airborne
w = 0.35

the transform is the foot CENTRE and
an ankle roll raises it 15 cm
